Experiment 1 Method (p. 243) identifies a final sample of 141 undergraduate participants after excluding four who tried to memorize distracting words; this sample applies to the combined recall analyses. However, p. 244 separately reports individual-word recall, correctly recalled sets, total words in correctly recalled sets, and longest correctly recalled set, each with its own F, p and d. The input does not identify which of these endpoints is assigned; no test was selected from input order, requested metric, or replication reference. Statistic fields remain null because a unique test cannot be established. The supplied broad description also mentions reverse digit span and response inhibition, which are not the Experiment 1 recall outcomes. No original statistics were taken from replication sources. Reported success and replication were not assessed because target_side is original.
